runtime.execution: Go goroutine runtime, provider stream loop, parallel tool batches and native/background OS processes.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns sessions, toolset supervision, child jobs and native memory DB adapter; consumes providers, MCP/toolsets and configured evaluator endpoints.

summary: Programmable hook-driven coding team with steering/follow-up queues, model changes, subagents and managed compaction.

inspection.scope: provider/dispatch loop, tool/hook contracts, OS job lifetime, delegation, SQLite compaction, memory/evaluator contracts and direct test assertions
inspection.limits: No upstream execution; broad runtime sampled through selected actual surfaces. MCP/provider dependencies and full configuration/CLI paths not exhaustively traced.

actions.name: read_file / edit_file / write_file / search_files_content
actions.lifecycle: awaited dispatch; result appended subject to cap
actions.authority: model within toolset permissions/hooks; native host filesystem

actions.name: shell
actions.lifecycle: await child; cancel group TERM then direct-child KILL
actions.authority: model approved native host shell, ordinary command authority opaque

actions.name: run_background_job / list_background_jobs / view_background_job / wait_background_job / stop_background_job
actions.output: job_<epoch>_<counter>, bounded output/status/exit; optional recall steering
actions.lifecycle: host Map tracks request-independent child; not restored heap/daemon service
actions.authority: model via permissions; completion can steer runtime if recall enabled

actions.name: transfer_task / handoff / run_skill
actions.input: configured target agent or skill, task/expected output
actions.lifecycle: fresh child session, attached-file/lineage propagation; forwarding waits drained child
actions.authority: caller-scoped agent resolver, pin protects concurrent foreground routing

actions.name: RunAgent
actions.input: SubSessionConfig with agent/task/context settings and content callback
actions.lifecycle: pinned child stream collecting; completion hook on failure/cancel
actions.authority: runtime-resolved caller; no implied full parent context

actions.name: Steer / FollowUp / CancelSteer
actions.lifecycle: urgent after current batch; followups full subsequent turns
actions.authority: runtime client controls steering; queued message hook may veto

actions.name: change_model / revert_model
actions.lifecycle: subsequent request model selection; per caller
actions.authority: tool permissions plus caller agent rather than unscoped global

actions.name: before_llm_call / before_compaction / tool_input_transform / tool_guard
actions.input: event JSON + command/builtin/model configuration, updated messages/input/summary
actions.lifecycle: timed hooks at explicit loop phases; partial failed output nonauthoritative
actions.authority: operator authors hooks, registered handler boundary; guard decisions policy-governed

actions.name: add_memory / get_memories / search_memories / update_memory / delete_memory
actions.output: ID, JSON list or DB error
actions.lifecycle: await injected DB mutation/query; record timestamp not effect-journal transaction
actions.authority: model tool approval; memory DB adapter owns storage separately from callable schema

actions.name: RestartToolset / Evaluator.Evaluate
actions.input: toolset display name; separately configured evaluation state
actions.output: restart error or typed Result probabilities/score/usage
actions.lifecycle: restart lifecycle serialized; evaluator HTTP timed independently
actions.authority: runtime/operator configuration and endpoint credentials; assessment policy left caller

filesystem.detail: Native filesystem read/edit/write/search/directory toolset, passed through approval/hook dispatcher.

processes.detail: Foreground native shell with group cancellation and background jobs with recall, wait/list/view/stop handles; deliberate request-independent background lifetime.

code_actions.detail: Shell/command-hook programs provide ordinary opaque native computation; no traced structured notebook/code-action state or persistent language kernel.

persistent_kernel.detail: Background shell job exists beyond request but per-host job Map/output buffer; does not serialize interpreter heap or restore owned handle after rebuild.

standing_database.detail: Injected native memory DB CRUD/search and SQLite session/summary storage; these local harness-owned stores differ from externally governed general computation services.

workflow_programming.detail: Event hook registry/pipeline with command/builtin/model handlers, task/skill/handoff delegation and runtime-managed actions; imperative workflow through tools/hooks rather than durable graph replay.

multi_model.detail: Provider fallback and model change/revert; pinned child agents run their own configured models without global foreground mutation.

live_collaboration.detail: Concurrent subagent streams and completion recall steer foreground; selected delegation surfaces are task-oriented, not traced peer room/mail protocol.

concurrent_work.detail: Parallel tool batches/background jobs and pinned agent sessions; interactive confirmations serialize because decisions unkeyed by call ID.

steering_interrupt.detail: Urgent steer after current batch and queued followups; batch cancellation settles error responses; foreground group TERM but KILL escalates direct child, backgrounds deliberately remain request-independent.

turn_redefinition.detail: Before-LLM hook can stop/rewrite messages; custom compaction summary/veto, tool transform/guard and command/builtin/model hook registry reshape normal execution.

compaction.detail: Managed applied/skipped/failed outcomes, custom/native/LLM modes; atomic stored metadata+summary and provider-specific continuation payload.

context_repair.detail: Retained pre-summary items and readable fallback summary plus configurable precompaction hook support reconstruction; no automatic corruption-repair protocol established.

original_audit.detail: Stored session/history and typed events preserve many originals through summary; configured textual tool cap applies BEFORE append, hook guards may suppress bodies and OS capture is bounded.

audit_query.detail: SQLite session_items/summary structure and structured memory queries available; this storage is not complete original request/effect/queryable audit.

hot_change.detail: Toolset restart lifecycle serialization and post-tool reprobe updates next iteration tool discovery. Selected path lacks full config/code refit with all owned work paused/drained.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Reopen resumes logical session/native compaction payload; transient child pin/lineage/job maps and active provider/OS handles are not durable continuations.

remote_services.detail: Consumes provider fallback, external toolsets and separately configured typed evaluator endpoint; local native jobs are harness-owned rather than fabric-managed.

self_improvement.detail: Command hooks/evaluators can be composed into experiments; typed assessment primitive leaves policy to caller and selected source does not establish governed self-modifying harness research.

complaints.detail: Error/loop notifications, hook diagnostics and session/tool identities support attributable faults; state-capturing external complaint/bead DB not established.

authority.detail: Ordered session/team permissions and mode/guard/hook approval outcomes. Autonomous removes mode prompts but session ask remains authoritative; noninteractive approval has explicit deny path.

evaluation.detail: Independent typed boolean/choice/score evaluator contracts and test oracles; assessment does not itself select or promote harness changes.

time_order.detail: Mutex-assigned append positions and compaction transaction order; concurrent tools execute independent, and queue messages activate after batches. IDs/time stamps are not full external causal-effect settlement.

evidence.claim: Before-provider hooks may stop/rewrite messages; fallback provider chain executes request with current tools/budget admission.
Records assistant message then dispatches tool batch, reprobes toolsets for next iteration, detects repetition and drains urgent steering after tools.
Independent model calls run parallel through concurrent MapSlice; cancellation stops siblings, confirmations serialized because resume decisions lack call IDs.
Binds change_model/revert_model/transfer_task/handoff/run_skill and ordered permission tiers; session ask beats every safety mode.
Native shell starts process group, collects output, waits on completion/cancel, SIGTERM then direct-child SIGKILL escalation.
Unix Setpgid and negative-PID SIGTERM group; direct-child escalation in shell handler is not universal group SIGKILL.
Background job ID/job map, bounded writer, child deliberately outlives request context; monitor can enqueue completion recall.
In-memory background handle/output cap 10MB; grandchild pipe-close may truncate output/SIGPIPE, recommends daemon output redirection.
Steer admitted after current tool batch; FollowUp queues full next turns one message at a time, queue-full error and cancel-steer ID.
Fresh child context/task instructions inherits attached files, agent options and delegation lineage rather than full implicit parent history.
Forwarding delegation pins background parent separately from shared foreground agent and drains child events for completion hooks.
Background collecting child resolves caller from pinned session and streams/forwards usage, completion hook even failure/cancel.
Before-compaction hook veto/custom summary; native or delegated LLM strategy, terminal outcomes distinguish applied/skipped/failed.
SQLite compaction metadata+summary row one transaction, apply in-memory only after commit; not arbitrary tool-effect transaction.
Session append middle-out caps textual tool payload at ingestion and clears request-only assembly marks before stored transcript.
Configured ingestion cap and prompt backstop have bounded/unlimited settings; old-call prompt truncation separate.
RestartToolset uses canonical lifecycle wrapper restart serialization; display-name collisions skip nonrestartable matches. No whole runtime compile/refit barrier here.
Registered command/builtin/model handlers operate on event JSON with timeout, cancellation normalization and partial output dropped on failure.
Native add/get/delete/search/update memory dispatch to injected DB with ID/category/created timestamp and JSON results.
Configured typesafe evaluator independent endpoint/env credentials per evaluation and timeout; builds boolean/choice/score questions.
Evaluator returns typed probabilities/choice/score/usage; caller determines policy, not autonomous harness optimization.
Native read/edit/write/list/search/mkdir/rmdir tools expose filesystem handlers and schema.
SQLite reopen oracle preserves original items, summary/first-kept/native provider block; another provider gets readable summary but not block replay.
Composition test asserts transform patches retain unrelated fields and caller original not mutated; failure policy retains prior patches.

tests.focus: provider-native summary persistence/reopen and cross-provider replay boundary
tests.oracle: Mock compactor plus real temporary SQLite reopen checks four retained items, first-kept index, exact native block, readable fallback and provider-scoped replay. Tests continuation data, not summary faithfulness or live request refit.

tests.focus: hook patch composition, immutability, failure policy and verdict classes
tests.oracle: Exact map/string and Allowed/exit-code assertions prove ordered patch accumulation and original input unchanged; command fixtures only source-read. No cross-process/harness upgrade oracle.
HTTP fixture table matches exact parsed boolean/choice/score/usage JSON including zero confidence and ties. Measures protocol conversion, not assessment correctness or optimization benefit.

strengths: Hooks materially reshape normal turns, tools and compaction; not observation-only.
Pinned sub-session routing and explicit urgent/follow-up queues expose useful concurrency ownership.
Atomic summary continuation plus provider-specific opaque block retained alongside earlier items.
limits: Captured tool text may already be capped before stored append; complete originals need separate retention.
Request-independent in-memory background jobs are not restartable computation services; daemonized inherited pipes have explicit loss/SIGPIPE boundary.
Toolset restart/reprobe is narrower than whole-harness refit; evaluation primitive is not autoresearch.
arconaut_questions: Can mutable phase hooks retain exact pre/post representations and versioned authority decisions without imposing routine prompts?
How should an owned-work inventory distinguish request-independent jobs from shared daemon consumers before refit?
Can provider-native summary blocks coexist with repairable, queryable originals and cross-model context portability?
